# LaSuite Meet

> LaSuite Meet is open-source video conferencing built on LiveKit, developed by DINUM, the French government's digital agency, and self-hostable under the MIT licence. This file indexes its documentation for language models: each link is the page's Markdown source, and the rendered site is at https://documentation-meet.beta.numerique.gouv.fr/.

Most of what an administrator can change is a backend setting, an environment variable. Start from Customising Meet, which lists every change in plain words with a link to its guide and its variable, then Environment Variables for the exact name, default and file. Optional features ship switched off in the example files: a Docker Compose profile, a commented block of `values.yaml` or `env.d/common`, which the feature's guide says to switch on. After installing or changing Meet, run every command check of [Check your install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/verify.md) and report each output, then ask the user to run its browser checks, the two-device call included.

## Customising and settings

- [Customising Meet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/customising.md): everything an administrator can change, its default, and the guide and variable for each
- [Environment Variables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/env-variables.md): every variable per service, required or not, its default and meaning

## Self-hosting

- [Self-hosting overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/index.md): the install paths and when each fits
- [Quick Start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/compose/quick-start.md): one script installing Meet, a reverse proxy and Keycloak on a fresh Linux server
- [Docker Compose prerequisites](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/compose/prerequisites.md): server size, domain names and ports
- [Docker Compose Deployment Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/compose/deployment-guide.md): the stacks by hand, after-installation steps, upgrading, rolling back, stopping
- [Reverse Proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/compose/reverse-proxy.md): nginx-proxy or Traefik in front of the stacks
- [Kubernetes prerequisites](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/kubernetes/prerequisites.md): cluster, ingress, cert-manager and external services
- [Helm Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/kubernetes/helm.md): the Meet and LiveKit charts, secrets, upgrading, uninstalling
- [Scalingo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/scalingo.md): Meet as a Scalingo app with PostgreSQL and Redis add-ons
- [Check your install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/verify.md): the checks that prove an install works as configured and carries calls, each with its command and its expected output

## Configuration

- [LiveKit and TURN](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/livekit.md): the media server, its ports and TURN
- [Firewall and ports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/firewall.md): every port to open, the traffic flows and the Docker networks
- [SSO and authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/sso.md): OpenID Connect providers and unauthenticated access
- [Recording](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/recording.md): LiveKit Egress, S3-compatible storage and download links
- [AI transcription](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/transcription.md): the summary service, speech-to-text and LaSuite Docs output
- [Real-time subtitles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/subtitles.md): the LiveKit agent and its speech-to-text provider
- [Telephony](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/telephony.md): dial-in through LiveKit SIP
- [Email](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/email.md): SMTP for invitations and recording links
- [Theming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/theming.md): colours, fonts, logo and images without a rebuild

## Operating

- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/security.md): TLS, services that must never be public, rate limits, the authentication model
- [Room purge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/room-purge.md): deleting inactive rooms
- [Audit logging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration/audit-logging.md): the audit events, their fields and how to query them
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes and fixes

## Integrating

- [External API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/external-api.md): creating and managing rooms from another application, the two token modes, errors
- [OpenAPI, application token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/openapi.yaml): every route with its schemas, for a token your backend requests for a user
- [OpenAPI, user's OIDC token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/resource_server.yaml): the same rooms routes, for the token your user got from your OIDC provider
- [Add-ons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/reference/external-api-addons.md): add-ins such as Outlook's, and their sign-in flow

## Using Meet

- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/user/getting-started.md): joining and running a first meeting
- [Features and controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/user/features-controls.md): every control in a meeting, roles and permissions
- [Recording and transcription, for users](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/user/recording.md): starting a recording and getting the file
- [Accessibility and shortcuts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/user/accessibility.md): keyboard, screen readers and display settings
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/faq.md): common questions from participants and hosts
- [How Meet works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suitenumerique/meet/main/docs/overview/how-meet-works.md): the architecture, what is stored, security and media
